feliz FE-4 before any other feliz row

elixir ELX-ESCAPE-FUNNEL first in its packet
it is the one code-injection row in the ledger (`#{}` interpolation spliced from .ddd string literals at four unescaped emit sites); everything else in the packet is correctness.
the seed family (SEED-* + CB-C6) as one cross-backend packet-crossing slice

SEED-EVENTSOURCED / SEED-RAW-DOCUMENT / SEED-DATASET-NAME-COLLISION / SEED-TENANT-NULL all reduce to 'the seeder does not know the aggregate's shape or its principal'; four independent per-backend fixes would each need the same validator decision.
the TPH cluster (CB-C2/C3/C4/C10/C11/C12) as one slice across dotnet-adapters, node-ts and validator-diagnostics

all six come from reading capability/stance facts off `agg.capabilities` and the aggregate's own plural instead of resolving through the supertype/root-table; fixing them one backend at a time re-derives the same rule three times.
its goldens are regenerated from backend emission; landing it first means regenerating twice.
